emails.subject: Re: Kaya Butter Toast Review - Tomorrow 8:30am Live Re-Taste
emails.text:
Hey Daniel & Wei Ling,

My reel from yesterday ('Did Nanyang Kopi shrink their butter slice?!') just crossed 90,000 views. I love your coffee, so I'm happy to come down tomorrow morning at 8:30am to film a live re-taste and show your kitchen's side.

My usual rate is SGD 600, or I can do SGD 450 if you throw in 20 of your Kaya Toast plushie keychains for my comment-section giveaway. One condition: whatever butter cut and toast prep you serve me on camera has to be the exact same standard every regular customer gets, because my followers will check.

Cheers,
Zack (@MakanWithZack)

emails.subject: Price Notice: Anchor Golden Salted Butter 25kg Block (+35% Q4 Surcharge)
emails.text:
Dear Nanyang Kopi & Toast Purchasing,

Please note that wholesale pricing for Anchor Golden Salted Butter (New Zealand grass-fed) has increased by 35% effective this month.

At your current Set A price ($4.80), increasing portion weight from 12g to 20g per toast set adds SGD 0.42 in raw dairy cost per set (approx. SGD 1,100/month across 90 daily sets). For takeaway orders, packing the 12g chilled slab in a separate side butter cup ($0.05/unit) or steam-vented box prevents melting without increasing butter weight.

Regards,
Account Team
Fonterra Foodservice Singapore

emails.subject: Raffles Place #B1-14 Counter Inspection Note - Cash Handling vs Ready-to-Eat Toast
emails.text:
Dear Licensee (Nanyang Kopi & Toast, #B1-14),

Following our pre-opening inspection, please be reminded that food handlers slicing ready-to-eat kaya butter toast and cracking soft-boiled eggs may not handle loose coins or currency notes unless they remove gloves and wash hands between every transaction (+40s delay per order).

Regards,
Environmental Health Officer
